verdicts.reason: A: the Pre-order CTA sits top-left beside the headphones as if it were a tag, so the reading order starts with the action. The teal disc has come loose from the headphones and dropped to the bottom-left, where it covers the tiny, unreadable OBSIDIAN logo. The centred price also clashes with the left-aligned headline. B: it has the same problems: the CTA is on top, the disc is stranded, and the logo is small and sits on the disc. The left-aligned headline and body copy also break its centred axis, and the body line is jammed under the headline. Still, B's CTA, headphones and price share one centred column, so it reads as slightly more deliberate than A's arbitrary side-by-side top row.
